The University of California, Irvine is seeking qualiﬁed candidates for a Clinical Associate Hospitalist position for inpatient coverage. Duties will include clinical service primarily at the UCI site in Los Alamitos Hospital.
Minimum Qualiﬁcations
Candidates must possess an M.D./D.O. or equivalent degree
Board-certiﬁed or eligible in the ﬁeld of Internal Medicine or Family Practice
Eligible for California licensure
Experienced in providing and/or oversight of care

Per Diem shift rates for a Clinical Associate - Hospitalists range from $2,340 - $2,760 per 12-hour shift based on day vs night shift. Per-dem Clinical Associates will be paid bi-weekly based on hours worked during pay period.
Clinical responsibilities will involve:
Coordinate and ensure patient care coverage for Medicine services
Conduct face-to-face rounds with the care team
Collaborate with Emergency Medicine and Intensivists on cases; hospitalists will not serve as primary admitting providers.
Monitor patient stability and triage cases
Oversee consultations and collaborate with specialists
Participate in family meetings and patient care discussions
Ensure timely completion of patient notes within 24 hours
Maintain compliance with medical record standards and institutional policies
Primary responsibilities of this position:
Maintain the highest standards of safety and quality in patient care
Provide appropriate general hospital medicine care and management of patients including but not limited to evaluation, treatment, and follow-up care.
Supervise individuals who participate in the care of patients
Model professionalism and patient-centered care
Participate in quality improvement initiatives
Complete computer-based training and timesheets on schedule
Support development of clinical protocols and care delivery optimization
Your role on the team:
Demonstrated experience in quality improvement to improve patient outcomes.
Leadership skills: ability to motivate, inspire, communicate with patients, families, staff, faculty, and peers to maintain a professional, team-based approach in the care of patients.
Adhere to departmental policies, procedures, and objectives while in compliance of all UC policies and procedures. Maintain patient conﬁdentiality and comply with all state and federal privacy laws.
